The '''Royal Hunting Lodge''' was the [[Iziz ruling family|Onderon Royal Family]] residence in the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] wilds. It was used as a base by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]] during a political crisis in [[3627 BBY]].
